request.description:
Allows the authenticated user to create an instant payment to a business.
Optionally provide recipientWalletAddress to send to a specific wallet of that business (address must belong to the business).

query.description: Comma-separated list of payment statuses to filter by. Available statuses: queued, requested, initiated, lockbox, released, partial, cancelled, declined, completed, failed. Example: "completed,lockbox" (optional).
Filter payments by specific wallet ID. Must be a valid UUID format (optional).
Filter payments created after this date (ISO 8601 format) (optional).
Filter payments created before this date (ISO 8601 format) (optional).
Filter payments with transaction amount greater than or equal to this value (optional).
Filter payments with transaction amount less than or equal to this value (optional).
Filter payments with sender business ID (optional).
Filter payments with recipient business ID (optional).
Filter payments where sender or recipient matches business ID (optional).. This is a legacy filter that is no longer supported.
Filter payments by description (case-insensitive partial match) (optional).
Sort payments by a field. Available fields: createdAt, updatedAt. (optional).
Sort direction. Available values: asc, desc. Example: "asc" (optional).
the maximum number of payments returned. Default: 100. Max: 200.(optional).
page offset to start from (based on the limit). Default: 0.(optional).
